chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Maythami, from Aban, from Isma'il al-Ju'fi, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام:

Concerning two men who bought a slave-girl jointly, then one of them had intercourse with her without his partner: he عليه السلام said, “He is to be given half of the hadd punishment, and he is to be made liable for half of the value if he makes her pregnant.”

key_terms.أَحْبَلَ: he caused her to become pregnant
key_terms.جَارِيَةً: a female slave-girl owned as property
key_terms.فَنَكَحَهَا: then he had intercourse with her
key_terms.نِصْفَ الْحَدِّ: half of the prescribed hadd punishment
key_terms.نِصْفَ الْقِيمَةِ: half of her monetary value as compensation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one of two co-owners has intercourse with a jointly owned slave-girl and causes pregnancy?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a jointly owned slave-girl when one co-owner has intercourse with her without the consent or participation of the other owner. It establishes both a penal consequence and a financial liability, showing the protection of shared ownership rights within fiqh.
